sketch: Friendly, fast to quote, slow to reply once paid. Bundles services you did not ask for. Knows the real answer to most compliance questions but only shares it when asked precisely.
Invisible. Communicates only through resubmission notices with a one-line reason. The same filing sails through for one founder and bounces three times for another.
Wants the current account opened as much as you do, until the KYC rule he didn't know about. Will suggest 'come back Monday' as a solution to anything.
Agrees with everything. Timeline is always six weeks. Disappears after the advance is paid and a project manager takes over.
Replies on WhatsApp within minutes, delivers on a schedule you cannot see. Every delay is a 'small change in scope'.
Loves the idea within a minute of hearing it. Wants to help, then wants to join, then wants to know what percent. Reliability rolls each week.
Asks the same question at every visit: what about the job. The question gets slightly sharper each time, and softer for a week after any good news.
Supportive in principle, tracks the EMI in practice. Notices the balance before you do, especially since you chose not to look.
Genuinely wants the product. Has no authority over procurement, which will ask for documents you do not have.
Polite, process-bound, immovable. Needs a GST invoice, a vendor form, a cancelled cheque and a signed MSA before anything moves.
